\begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. chA:A.62Suppose $\pi : \tilde{M} \to M$ is a covering map. Show that $\tilde{M}$ is compact if and only if $M$ is compact and $\pi $ is a finite-sheeted covering. \end{exercise}

We will revisit smooth covering maps at the end of Appendix C.
